measurement_source: operator marks centre of AssistiveTouch accessibility cursor
operator_reason: Cursor centre appears easier to locate; orange trace might lag. Relative rendering lag is an operator hypothesis, not measured evidence.
scope: Cursor-position accuracy; correspondence to the game's instantaneous received touch position/timing is not established by cursor marks alone.
contact_confirmation: Existing orange-trail confirmation remains an independent requirement for a qualified contact-position score. Do not infer confirmation from a cursor mark or relabel an unchecked confirmation.
boundaries: Cursor is also visible during hover; retain independently observed contact/lift boundaries and interruption assessment.
